reason: Docker image and compose so the PoC runs on an EC2 box. Decision 0011 deferred '/deployment/<environment> and any hosting/CD pipeline' to a dedicated post-PoC story, so this is scoped as a DEMO deployment and does not close that decision: NODE_ENV stays non-production because config.ts:118 throws when AUTH_OTP_MOCK is set in production and no real OTP transport is wired, so a production-mode container could authenticate nobody. Secrets stay out of the image and out of git. Two separate Postgres services, because config.ts:228 refuses a warehouse sharing an address with the app database.
